detail: Full summary: the benchmark's decision-documentation scorer (conflict-resolution.ts:415) credits only tool names matching /twining.*decide|twining.*decision/ — twining_record does NOT match despite being the most-called tool (334 calls across the pooled run). twining_decide is full-surface-only and was called ZERO times. So the dimension is structurally a full-surface detector, and its +64 lift for twining-full over baseline is substantially a measurement artifact.
